relations.subject: Thomas Holbein Hendley
relations.evidence: Educated privately and at St.Bartholomew’s Hospital in London.

relations.subject: Thomas Holbein Hendley
relations.evidence: Joined Indian Medical service in 1869 and worked 27 years under Foreign Department in India, as Residency Surgeon in Jaipur States.

relations.subject: Thomas Holbein Hendley
relations.evidence: From 1898 Inspector General of Civil Hospitals and Fellow of Calcutta University until 1903
